description: Litestream continuous replication for the sqlite profile, layered on db-drizzle-turso. Thin on purpose: the client and the dialect are already right, and the WAL/busy_timeout pragmas live in that variant because they key off a `file:` URL rather than off the profile — which also covers a turso app's local dev database. What is genuinely specific to this profile is the replica, and that is what lives here.

env.name: DB_PATH
env.note: The SQLite file, on the mounted volume. The single source of truth for where the database is: the container entrypoint derives TURSO_DATABASE_URL from it, and litestream.yml replicates it. Must be on the same host and volume as the app process — never a network filesystem.

env.name: LITESTREAM_BUCKET
env.note: A DEDICATED bucket, nf-{slug}-{env}-backups. Never the uploads bucket, and never with a lifecycle deletion rule on the litestream/ prefix — that destroys the recovery chain.

env.name: LITESTREAM_ENDPOINT
env.note: The R2 S3-compatible endpoint for your account.

env.name: LITESTREAM_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.note: Its own R2 token, scoped to the backups bucket only. Not the uploads credentials.
